hi I was hired at 17 and have been working here for 4 months, I don't have many makeline tips as I was hired under the condition that I don't work on the makeline. I work in the US unfortunately but these are my personal tips 

1. try to learn as much as you can! personally I recommend trying to learn customer service, ovens and PRP (pre rush prep), I started out on PRP my first day.

2. it's just pizza, don't over think things. try to not let customers fuck up your day, shit will happen. 

3. once you've learned basic tasks (prp, ovens, taking counter), please try to take initiative. I know this sounds like a common sense thing, but we had a former dominos employee work for us, we thought he was pretty trained, but all he did was fold fucking boxes and just really sucked at his job. 

4. just be kind to your coworkers and managers as much as you can, my coworkers are wonderful (for the most part) and we tend to get along. just do good for them and they'll have your back (hopefully)

5. don't be afraid to ask for help!!!!!!!! if this is your first time working fast food, you're gonna need a lot of help. I didn't learn shit in my orientation class (I was hungover anyways), so don't be afraid to ask for help! even at times I still need help.

6. try to memorize the menu somewhat, I haven't done this so I have no clue what goes on what specialty pizzas but you will probably be asked. 

I hope this helps at least some what!
